questions.stem: What incidence of awareness was traditionally reported for general anaesthetics?
In older reports, which specialty had an awareness incidence of 1:43?
What overall awareness incidence did NAP5, the largest study, report?
What awareness incidence did NAP5 report for general anaesthetics given with paralysis?
What awareness incidence did NAP5 report for general anaesthetics without paralysis?
During which two phases of anaesthesia does accidental awareness most often occur?
In NAP5, what share of awareness cases occurred during maintenance?
In NAP5, what share of awareness patients reported pain or distress?
What do memories of accidental awareness usually consist of?
options: Detailed recall of the whole operation
Brief sounds or sensations, such as a tube in the mouth
Clear memory of conversations in theatre
Vivid recall of pain during surgery

questions.stem: What determines how the psychological effects of accidental awareness vary?
questions.answer: The individual patient and their experience

questions.stem: How much does neuromuscular blockade increase the risk of accidental awareness?
Which planned emergence technique carries an awareness risk in NAP5?
What did NAP5 suggest about a personal or family history of awareness?
In NAP5, what share of maintenance-phase awareness cases had no explanation?
In accidental awareness risk, which obstetric procedure carries the highest risk?
How should patients be warned of accidental awareness risk at consent, under NAP5?
questions.answer: Warn all patients, in proportion to their risk

questions.stem: What should consent for sedation, not general anaesthesia, emphasise about awareness?
questions.answer: That the patient will be awake and may recall parts of the procedure

questions.stem: At induction, when should the effect of an adequate IV dose be confirmed to prevent awareness?
Which basic vigilance measures help prevent awareness from drug or equipment errors?
questions.answer: Label all drugs; check pumps are programmed and plugged in

questions.stem: If awareness is suspected during maintenance, what three steps does NAP5 advise?
questions.answer: Reassure verbally, add analgesia and deepen anaesthesia

questions.stem: NAP5: use the smallest blocker dose giving adequate conditions, titrated with a ____ (essential).
What does NAP5 advise for total intravenous anaesthesia (TIVA)?
Which monitor may help indicate level of consciousness and so lower awareness risk?
In NAP5, what share of general anaesthetics used depth-of-anaesthesia monitoring?
At emergence, what two checks should come before waking the patient?
questions.answer: Confirm surgery is finished, then confirm full reversal

questions.stem: How common is dreaming around surgery, which is not awareness?
Which standard interview is used to detect awareness after anaesthesia?
Which signs during anaesthesia may suggest awareness?
Which depth monitor reading may suggest awareness during anaesthesia?
When awareness is suspected during surgery, what is the first action?
Immediate management of suspected awareness: reassure the patient that they are ____.
Which drug is given as a bolus to deepen anaesthesia promptly if awareness is suspected?
If TIVA may have failed from a pump fault or extravasation, what should be done?
questions.answer: Switch to a volatile at once
